nodes.name: store.rs
nodes.summary: Defines KeyStore, the serializable root model persisted to credentials.json, with CRUD accessors for looking up, inserting, and deleting stored ModelKey entries by agent type or id.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Defines ModelType (the enum of every supported AI coding agent and API provider) plus AuthMethod, ProviderProtocol, HealthStatus, and the core ModelKey/ModelAlias/ModelVariant structs used throughout the key store.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for key-vault: declares its modules (auto_detect, commands, key_store, provider_config, providers, types, etc.) and re-exports the crate's public API surface for consumption by the Tauri app.

nodes.name: provider_config.rs
nodes.summary: Static registry mapping each ModelType to a ProviderConfig describing its env var names, default base URL, supported protocols, and (for multi-region providers) alternate endpoints.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: AnthropicValidator validates a direct Anthropic API key by listing models and sending a minimal test message, used for the AnthropicApi provider type.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: AzureOpenAIValidator validates Azure OpenAI credentials by probing the deployments/models endpoint of the configured Azure resource.

nodes.name: KeyStore
nodes.summary: Root model persisted as credentials.json: a versioned collection of ModelKey entries with lookup, insertion and deletion helpers keyed by agent type and/or key id.

nodes.name: ModelType
nodes.summary: Enum of every supported CLI coding agent and direct API provider (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kiro, OpenAI-compatible APIs, Anthropic, Bedrock, Azure, etc.), with helpers to classify a variant as an API-key provider, CLI agent, ACP agent, or marketplace-native provider.

nodes.name: AuthMethod
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing API-key authentication from OAuth authentication for a stored credential.

nodes.name: ProviderProtocol
nodes.summary: Enum of the wire protocol a provider speaks (OpenAI-style or Anthropic-style), used to pick the right request/response shape.

nodes.name: HealthStatus
nodes.summary: Enum tracking a key's last-known health (Valid, Degraded, Invalid, Unknown) as reported by validation or live usage.

nodes.name: ModelKey
nodes.summary: The core stored credential record: id, name, provider type, API key/session token, base URL, protocol, auth method, quota info, health status, OAuth refresh-failure tracking, and configured model aliases/variants.

nodes.name: ModelAlias
nodes.summary: A user-facing display alias (name + icon) mapped to an underlying model id.

nodes.name: ModelVariant
nodes.summary: A model variant definition (e.g. reasoning/fast mode) mapping a display model to a concrete base model and context window.

nodes.name: DefaultVariant
nodes.summary: Records which model variant is the default for a given base model.

nodes.name: ProviderEndpointSpec
nodes.summary: Static spec for an alternate regional/vendor endpoint of a provider (id, label, base URL, optional Anthropic-compatible base URL).

nodes.name: ProviderEndpoint
nodes.summary: Runtime endpoint descriptor derived from a ProviderEndpointSpec via a `From` conversion.

nodes.name: ProviderConfig
nodes.summary: Describes how to configure a given provider: its API key/base-URL env var names, default base URL, supported protocols, default protocol, and any alternate endpoints.

nodes.name: ModelsResponse
nodes.summary: Deserialization target for Anthropic's list-models API response.

nodes.name: ModelInfo
nodes.summary: A single model entry (id, context length) from Anthropic's models list.

nodes.name: MessagesRequest
nodes.summary: Request body for Anthropic's Messages API, used to send a minimal test message.

nodes.name: Message
nodes.summary: A single chat message (role + content) in an Anthropic Messages API request.

nodes.name: AnthropicValidator
nodes.summary: HTTP-client-backed validator for direct Anthropic API keys: lists models, sends a minimal test message, and does local format validation.

nodes.name: ModelsResponse
nodes.summary: Deserialization target for Azure OpenAI's deployments/models list response.

nodes.name: ModelInfo
nodes.summary: A single model/deployment entry (id, context length) from Azure OpenAI.

nodes.name: AzureOpenAIValidator
nodes.summary: HTTP-client-backed validator for Azure OpenAI resources: probes the deployments endpoint to confirm the API key and endpoint are valid.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Finds a key matching the given agent type and optional key id, falling back to any key of that agent type if no id is given.

nodes.name: get_by_id
nodes.summary: Finds a key by its id alone, regardless of agent type.

nodes.name: get_all
nodes.summary: Returns all keys configured for a given agent type.

nodes.name: set
nodes.summary: Inserts a new key or replaces an existing one with the same id.

nodes.name: delete
nodes.summary: Removes a key matching the given agent type and optional id.

nodes.name: delete_by_id
nodes.summary: Removes a key by id alone, regardless of agent type.

nodes.name: as_str
nodes.summary: Returns the canonical string identifier for a ModelType variant, used as the on-disk/API representation.

nodes.name: from_str
nodes.summary: Parses a canonical string identifier back into a ModelType variant.

nodes.name: is_api_key_provider
nodes.summary: Returns whether this ModelType represents a direct API-key provider (as opposed to a CLI agent).

nodes.name: is_cli_agent
nodes.summary: Returns whether this ModelType represents a CLI coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.) rather than a raw API provider.

nodes.name: needs_mitm_proxy
nodes.summary: Returns whether this agent type requires the local MITM proxy to inject credentials rather than plain env vars.

nodes.name: is_acp
nodes.summary: Returns whether this ModelType is an ACP (Agent Client Protocol) agent.

nodes.name: is_market_native
nodes.summary: Returns whether this ModelType is natively supported by the Orgii market/orchestrator.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new ModelKey for a given model type with sensible defaults for all other fields.

nodes.name: mask_api_key
nodes.summary: Returns a redacted version of the stored API key (e.g. first/last few characters visible) safe for logging or display.

nodes.name: mask_session_token
nodes.summary: Returns a redacted version of the stored session token safe for logging or display.

nodes.name: is_official_anthropic_endpoint
nodes.summary: Checks whether a base URL points at Anthropic's official API endpoint (as opposed to a proxy or third-party mirror).

nodes.name: is_claude_official_oauth_token
nodes.summary: Checks whether a token string matches the format of an official Claude Code OAuth-issued token.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a ProviderConfig with a single default protocol/endpoint.

nodes.name: with_protocols
nodes.summary: Constructs a ProviderConfig supporting multiple protocols with an explicit default.

nodes.name: default_anthropic_base_url
nodes.summary: Returns the default Anthropic-compatible base URL used when a provider config doesn't specify one.

nodes.name: get_provider_config
nodes.summary: Looks up the static ProviderConfig (env var names, base URL, protocols, endpoints) for a given ModelType, covering every supported API provider.

nodes.name: get_all_provider_configs
nodes.summary: Returns the ProviderConfig for every API-key provider ModelType, used to populate provider selection UI.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs an AnthropicValidator with the default timeout.

nodes.name: with_timeout
nodes.summary: Constructs an AnthropicValidator with a custom timeout.

nodes.name: validate
nodes.summary: Validates an Anthropic API key by listing models and sending a minimal test message, returning a ValidationResult with available models on success.

nodes.name: get_models
nodes.summary: Fetches the list of available models from Anthropic's models API.

nodes.name: test_messages
nodes.summary: Sends a minimal request to Anthropic's Messages API to confirm the key can actually perform inference.

nodes.name: validate_format
nodes.summary: Checks that an Anthropic API key string matches the expected `sk-ant-` prefix format, without a network call.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs an AzureOpenAIValidator with the default timeout.

nodes.name: validate
nodes.summary: Validates Azure OpenAI credentials by probing the deployments/models endpoint for the given resource.

nodes.name: get_models
nodes.summary: Fetches the list of deployed models from an Azure OpenAI resource.

nodes.name: try_get_models
nodes.summary: Attempts a single models-list request against a specific Azure OpenAI endpoint/API version.

nodes.name: validate_format
nodes.summary: Checks that an Azure OpenAI API key string is non-empty and well-formed, without a network call.
